decision: Keep existing implementation: shared epoll lowers forge CPU, but a repeatable >=4% wall geomean improvement is not established.

measurement.cpu: /proc/PID/stat utime+stime process counters, including all threads
measurement.round_interleaving: AB/BA; 3 independent fixture passes for discovery, separate fresh containers for confirmation
measurement.full_suite_order: Alternate or rotate variant order; fresh Node and Go processes each trial; unchanged conformance, fixtures and three benchmark rounds
measurement.limitations: Shared quota approximates a common sandbox; production has separate container quotas. Multiple comparisons and host drift make exploratory intervals descriptive.

epoll_full_pooled.limitations: Exploratory pooling across prototype revisions and host drift, not an independently confirmed speedup.

baseline.includes: fixtures, warmups, timed windows and lifecycle

verification.rebuild: Both architectures match original bytes on two builds
